text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara struggles to find a win. Yet 
the public begins to take notice of her as 
"the Umamusume who keeps trying no matter 
how many times she loses."

Meanwhile, interacting with the fans who 
joined her "Supporters' Club" lifts Haru 
Urara's motivation even higher.

Seeing her burning with motivation, her 
Trainer felt a strong urge to help her 
find a target race and lead her to a 
1st-place victory there.
